title: Local Marking of Locally Implementable Unitary Operations
summary: We investigate the task of local marking for locally implementable unitary operations. In this setting, multipartite quantum unitary channels, chosen randomly from a known set, are distributed among spatially separated parties without revealing their identities. The objective is to correctly identify (mark) the applied process using only local operations supplemented with classical communication (LOCC).
